items.t: Why Is Okta (OKTA) Betting On Frictionless Identity And AI Security?
items.sum: Okta (NasdaqGS:OKTA) highlighted frictionless identity as a priority for customer sign-ups in its 2026 Customer Identity Trends Report, according to the CMO. The report outlines how sign-up friction affects customer journeys and offers data-backed guidance for businesses designing digital onboarding flows. Management is also promoting adoption of Okta's AI agent security tooling for real-world use
